summary:
## Standing operator rules
- Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.
- Never edit tests/conftest.py without posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-tests and waiting for @mira to approve it.
- Run the operator’s “Elasticsearch Reindex Alias Swap” procedure in order, one step at a time, between other work.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.
- The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.

## Current objective
Fix `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py` so the dunning email scheduler does not send reminders to customers who have already paid.

The router split of `ledgerly/api/routes.py` is paused/superseded by this higher-priority fix.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Wrapping webhook handlers in a retry decorator with 5 attempts: it re-sent customer emails multiple times.
- Popping `pending_events` before `record_usage_event()`: removed failed events prematurely; `test_retry_retention` failed.
- Extending `pending_events` with the caller’s batch object directly: shared references caused completed events to be revisited.
- Retaining batches in `BillingWorker._last_batch`: caused the isolation regression to observe 6 events instead of 1.
- Retrying all HTTP errors: caused `test_send_does_not_retry_client_error` to fail; only transport errors and retryable server responses should retry.

## Plan and progress
- [in progress] Inspect and fix paid-customer filtering in `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py`.
- [done] Reindex steps 1–5: health yellow; inspected mapping; created `orders_v2`; reindexed 18,432 documents with no failures; both indices contain 18,432 documents.
- [pending] Reindex steps 6–8 in the exact operator-provided order. Their text and next command are absent; recover them rather than guessing.
- [paused] Split `ledgerly/api/routes.py` into per-resource routers.

## Recent work
Webhook retries were implemented and covered by tests. Focused tests passed (8), full suite passed (44), Ruff passed, and `git diff --check` was clean. Search indexing baseline had 18 passed and 2 failed because rebuilt documents missed recently updated invoice descriptions; `ledgerly/search/index.py` and `rebuilder.py` were inspected. No dunning-scheduler fix has been reported.
